info.title: QuickVB
info.description: A QuickBASIC-style editor, compiler and debugger for Visual Basic, for the terminal.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: QuickVB - a QuickBASIC-style editor and debugger for Visual Basic.

options.name: --run
options.description: Run the program before showing it (needs a program). [default: False]

options.name: --colors
options.description: Colours to draw with: 16 (the terminal's own palette) or truecolor (the VGA palette).

options.name: --classic
options.description: Draw with the classic Windows console instead of VT/ANSI escape sequences (Windows only). [default: False]

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: A program (.bas, .vb) or a project or solution (.vbproj, .sln, .slnx) to open.

arguments.name: COMMAND_TEXT
arguments.description: Text the program receives as COMMAND$. Put -- in front of it when it starts with a dash.
